def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    board = state_view.board
    captured = state_view.captured
    other = 1 - player_id
    own = board[player_id * 6:player_id * 6 + 6]
    opp = board[other * 6:other * 6 + 6]
    lead = captured[player_id] - captured[other]
    seeds = sum(own) - sum(opp)
    mobility = (own[0] > 0) + (own[1] > 0) + (own[2] > 0) + (own[3] > 0) + (own[4] > 0) + (own[5] > 0) - (opp[0] > 0) - (opp[1] > 0) - (opp[2] > 0) - (opp[3] > 0) - (opp[4] > 0) - (opp[5] > 0)
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, 0.55 * lead + 0.22 * seeds + 0.38 * mobility))

thought: For c0002, use a normalized side seed balance and a bounded mobility bonus alongside the captured lead.

def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    board = state_view.board
    captured = state_view.captured
    other = 1 - player_id
    own = board[player_id * 6:player_id * 6 + 6]
    opp = board[other * 6:other * 6 + 6]
    seed_diff = sum(own) - sum(opp)
    total = sum(own) + sum(opp)
    mobility_diff = (own[0] > 0) + (own[1] > 0) + (own[2] > 0) + (own[3] > 0) + (own[4] > 0) + (own[5] > 0) - (opp[0] > 0) - (opp[1] > 0) - (opp[2] > 0) - (opp[3] > 0) - (opp[4] > 0) - (opp[5] > 0)
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, 0.65 * (captured[player_id] - captured[other]) + 0.28 * seed_diff / (1 + total) + 0.16 * mobility_diff))

def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    board = state_view.board
    captured = state_view.captured
    other = 1 - player_id
    own = board[player_id * 6:player_id * 6 + 6]
    opp = board[other * 6:other * 6 + 6]
    own_weighted = own[0] + 2 * own[1] + 3 * own[2] + 4 * own[3] + 5 * own[4] + 6 * own[5]
    opp_weighted = opp[0] + 2 * opp[1] + 3 * opp[2] + 4 * opp[3] + 5 * opp[4] + 6 * opp[5]
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, 0.6 * (captured[player_id] - captured[other]) + 0.12 * (own_weighted - opp_weighted)))
